steps.note: Find the smallest value. Its index is also how many times the sorted array was rotated. Compare the middle with the right end of the range 0..6.
Middle 7 (pos 3) > right end 2 — the drop is to the right of mid, so the minimum is in 4..6.
Middle 1 (pos 5) ≤ right end 2 — mid..6 is sorted, so the minimum is mid or to its left: keep 4..5.
Middle 0 (pos 4) ≤ right end 1 — mid..5 is sorted, so the minimum is mid or to its left: keep 4..4.
Range closed on position 4: minimum 0. The array was rotated 4 time(s). 3 comparisons for 7 values — O(log n).
